svg.title: Lid-Driven Cavity: a verified 2-D Navier-Stokes solver
svg.desc: Project title beside the computed flow in the lid-driven cavity at Reynolds number 1000 on a 257 by 257 grid, drawn as a pixel mosaic of fluid speed with streamlines and tracer trails: one large clockwise vortex and two small counter-rotating corner eddies. Generated by scripts/build_readme_art.py from data/cavity_Re1000_N257.npz.
